summary.headline: Speaking review of four verb pairs: 7ammas / t7ammas, wajja3 / twajja3, daaya2 / tdaaya2, 7arrak / t7arrak

rules.title: 7ammas = make someone excited, t7ammas = get excited (same for the other three pairs)
rules.pattern: verb = do it to someone / t- + verb = it happens to you
bullets: The plain verb does it to someone: 7ammasni = he made me excited, wajja3tek? = did I hurt you?
Put t- in front and it happens to you: t7ammasna = we got excited, bnetwajja3 = we get hurt
Same pair for daaya2 / tdaaya2 (upset / get upset) and 7arrak / t7arrak (move / move yourself)
Commands follow the same split: 7ammsini = excite me, t7ammasi = get excited

examples.line: Amal: It's the wrong verb. It's get excited, not excite. -> t7ammasi
e7na bnetwajja3 bsur3a - we get hurt quickly
wala 7ada byetdaaya2 zayyik - nobody gets upset like you
eedi btet7arrak la7aalha - my hand moves on its own
